qualification: Design-only source-authoring asset. It is not a decoder, test, renderer run, admission, or credit record.

endpoint_wire_contract.resolution: A vertex id resolves only against base_model.nodes; a group id resolves only against explicit named subgraphs in the same record. No child substitution, forward lookup, implicit group, repeated-id merge, or label-based resolution is allowed.
endpoint_wire_contract.base_model_compatibility: base_model retains the existing direction/nodes/edges/subgraphs wire shape. Tagged edges are a separate supplement field and are never fed into the frozen base Flow400 decoder.
endpoint_wire_contract.edge_order: source_edge_order is an exact partition of every authored source link. Every index is unique and resolves to exactly one base or tagged edge.
